# open62541 / fuzz_json_decode_encode

open62541's own fuzz target `fuzz_json_decode_encode` ([source](source/fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over open62541 (open62541/open62541 at 12b72510).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: decodeJson(encodeJson(v)) == v for any Variant v that decodeJson accepted, compared with UA_order == UA_ORDER_EQ (full deep equality); the second decode must also return GOOD (BADOUTOFMEMORY excused).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against open62541 at commit 12b72510.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- decodeJson(encodeJson(v)) == v for any Variant v that decodeJson accepted, compared with UA_order == UA_ORDER_EQ (full deep equality); the second decode must also return GOOD (BADOUTOFMEMORY excused) ([lines 45-53](source/fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc#L45-L53)): assert(); compiled out.
- encodeJson is stable across a decode/encode cycle: the second encoding is byte-identical to the first (length and memcmp) ([lines 67-68](source/fuzz_json_decode_encode.cc#L67-L68)): assert(); compiled out.
